scope: Remove snapshot-coupled audit interfaces and bind candidate-freeze release to an explicit immutable artifact.

issues.fix: Derive N0/N1 from actual indexes; validate unique IDs, L1/L2 linkage, unambiguous CSV selection, and exact patient archive coverage.

issues.root_cause: A generic passed review was not bound to the candidate formula, code, analysis plan, or readiness summary and could be reused after artifact replacement.
issues.fix: Add a strict candidate manifest schema, semantic blinding checks, canonical summary/manifest hashes, and a separate release CLI that consumes an existing summary without rerunning the audit.
issues.verification: Synthetic ZIP-to-audit-to-release succeeds only with matching artifacts; changing the formula after review fails and does not create a handoff.
